d:
Experience the charm of classic Bollywood music with “Aaungi Ek Din Aaj Jaoon” from the 1981 Hindi film Baseraa! Featuring the legendary voice of Asha Bhosle, with music composed by R.D. Burman, this memorable song brings together the timeless appeal of Hindi film melodies and the screen presence of Rekha, Rakhee, and Shashi Kapoor.
Aaungi Ek Din Aaj Jaoon | Baseraa (1981) | Asha Bhosle | RD Burman | Rekha, Rakhee, Shashi Kapoor
Song: Aaungi Ek Din Aaj Jaoon
Movie: Baseraa (1981)
Star Cast: Rekha, Shashi Kapoor, Rakhee, Poonam Dhillon, Raj Kiran
Singer: Asha Bhosle
Music Director: R D Burman
